status: PRE-REGISTERED: written and committed before the selection helper and its tests existed. Cases, expected boundaries and reasons are not edited after results are seen; post-run notes go to the report, labelled as such.
scope: Structural association of an explicit Sphinx object anchor (a dt id) with its dt/dd group. A structurally complete unit is not a claim that the passage is factually sufficient for any question.
context_template: unit: {kind} signatures={signatures} descriptions={descriptions} start_lines={first_line}-{last_line} (parser-reported element start lines; not byte offsets)
context_template_note: lines joined with '\n' and a final '\n'; every byte of the query, source identity, labels and payload counts against budget_bytes; a unit that does not fit is a review case, never truncated
selection_rule: find elements whose id attribute equals the anchor exactly (no NFC, no percent-decoding, no case folding); exactly one must exist and be a dt whose class contains 'sig' and 'sig-object' (a Sphinx object signature); its parent dl is the object description; the unit is the maximal run of dt siblings containing it plus the run of dd siblings that follows, each element whole

representations.dom_serialization: lxml.html.tostring(element, method='html', encoding='unicode') of each unit element, the tails between unit elements included, the tail of the last one excluded; this is the parsed DOM, not the source bytes
representations.text_content: element.text_content() of each unit element with the same tails; no whitespace normalisation, nothing removed (scripts and button labels inside the dd stay)
representations.raw_byte_span: claimed only when the UTF-8 dom_serialization occurs exactly once, byte for byte, in the retained file

reasons.MISSING_ID: no element has this exact id
reasons.ID_NORMALIZATION_MISMATCH: no exact match, but an id matches after NFC normalisation or percent-decoding; reported, never selected
reasons.DUPLICATE_ID: more than one element has this exact id; no candidate is chosen
reasons.NOT_A_SIGNATURE: the element with the id is not a dt (label span, section, div ...); no unit boundary is defined for it here
reasons.NOT_SPHINX_OBJECT: the dt is not a Sphinx object signature (class lacks sig / sig-object), e.g. a glossary or field-list term
reasons.NO_DESCRIPTION: the dt run is not followed by any dd
reasons.EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: every dd of the group is empty (no child element, whitespace-only text)
reasons.MULTIPLE_GROUPS_IN_OBJECT_DL: the object dl holds more than one dt/dd group
reasons.STRAY_CONTENT_IN_OBJECT_DL: the object dl holds non-whitespace text or elements other than dt/dd
reasons.UNEXPECTED_NESTED_OBJECT: an object description is nested inside the dd of an object whose dl class has neither 'class' nor 'exception', or the anchor's own object dl sits inside such a dd
reasons.PARSER_RECOVERY_IN_UNIT: the parser error log has an entry whose line lies within the unit's parser-reported line range

hypotheses.H1: trafilatura.extract() structured output carries none of the anchor ids, so it cannot serve explicit anchor selection
hypotheses.H2: lxml.html get_element_by_id() returns one element for a duplicated id without signalling the duplicate
hypotheses.H3: lxml.html.tostring() with its default with_tail=True includes text that follows the element (stray dl text after a dd)

case_fields: structural is 'OK' or the list of reasons that must all be reported (other reasons, if any, are reported as findings); unit, must_include and must_exclude describe the candidate unit and are checked in both representations; raw_region names an entry of regions.json / the public region; dom_byte_identical true/false is a prediction, null means not predicted; budget per representation is 'fits', 'over' or null (not predicted)
public_region_rule: public:numpy.where = from the first byte of '<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="numpy.where">' to the end of the '</dd>' of the first '</dd></dl>' after it (computed by scripts/check_expectations.py from the retained bytes)
